title: EU Council vote
summary: A round table with 25 EU member states; your code lights up each seat as voting yes, no or abstaining.
description: An illustration of the Council of the EU around a round table, with one control per member state. Set a country to yes, no or abstain and its seat lights up: a coloured strip on the table edge in front of the member, a badge with a check, cross or dash that pops in, and a soft glow behind the chair. Set it back to none and the highlight fades out. Every country is an enum named after its two-letter code in lower case, so a whole vote is a few lines of code.

notes: Set a vote with `vm.enum("de").value = "yes"`. The values are `none`, `yes`, `no` and `abstain`; any other string is ignored.
The picture has 25 seats. Bulgaria (`bg`) and Slovakia (`sk`) have no seat in it, so there is no control for them.
Each change fades and pops by itself (about a third of a second), so setting all 25 at once still reads as a wave of lights. For a dramatic count, set them one by one with a short delay.
The file does not count the votes; your page knows the values it set, so it can show the tally and decide on a qualified majority.
